svg.text: Study phases
Core services to study:

sendPrompt('Explain Amazon RDS for the AWS Data Engineer exam')
sendPrompt('Explain AWS Glue for the AWS Data Engineer exam')

svg.text: Goals: IAM basics, data lake concepts, ETL fundamentals, AWS CLI practice
Resources: AWS Skill Builder free tier · AWS documentation · Stephane Maarek (Udemy)
Practice: Set up a free-tier AWS account and build a basic S3 + Glue pipeline
Focus services:

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain Amazon Redshift for the AWS Data Engineer exam')
sendPrompt('Explain Amazon EMR for the AWS Data Engineer exam')
sendPrompt('Explain AWS Lambda for data engineering on the AWS DEA exam')
sendPrompt('Explain Amazon Athena for the AWS Data Engineer exam')
sendPrompt('Explain AWS Step Functions for data pipelines on the DEA exam')

svg.text: Goals: Data pipeline design, batch vs streaming processing, data cataloging
Resources: A Cloud Guru · Official exam guide · AWS whitepapers on data analytics
Practice: Build end-to-end pipeline: Kinesis → Lambda → S3 → Athena query
Focus services:

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain AWS Lake Formation for the AWS Data Engineer exam')
sendPrompt('Explain Amazon QuickSight for the AWS Data Engineer exam')
sendPrompt('Explain CloudWatch monitoring for data pipelines on the DEA exam')
sendPrompt('Explain AWS KMS and encryption for data security on the DEA exam')
sendPrompt('Explain AWS Macie for data governance on the AWS DEA exam')

svg.text: Goals: Encryption at rest/transit, IAM policies, data quality monitoring, cost optimization
Resources: AWS Security Specialty study notes · re:Invent data sessions on YouTube
Practice: Configure Lake Formation permissions + CloudWatch alarms on Glue jobs
Activities:

svg.text: Target score: ≥720/1000 to pass · Exam format: 65 questions, 130 minutes, multiple choice
Tip: Flag uncertain questions and review; eliminate wrong answers first
Key topics that appear most on the exam

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain S3 storage classes and when to use each for the AWS DEA exam')

sendPrompt('Explain Kinesis Data Streams vs Kinesis Firehose for the AWS DEA exam')
